name: CRK like proto-oncogene, adaptor protein

function.text: CRKL encodes crk-like protein. Annotated molecular activities include RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding and signaling adaptor activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and Ras protein signal transduction.

function.text: CRKL encodes an adaptor protein containing SH2 and SH3 interaction domains. It participates in intracellular signal transmission through protein interactions, including pathways linked to RAS and JUN kinases. These domains organize signaling assemblies; they do not make CRKL itself an independently acting protein kinase.
